description: Writes the script you read out loud in the teleprompter. You can hand over your own words, or let a fresh ten minute talk be written from what the conversation and the campaign already know. Take it when the script is missing or no longer fits: "Write me a new script for Thursday, the offer changed." It needs the session and the webinar, and it replaces the script stored on your site, which answers with what it now holds. If you only want one passage changed, read the current script first. Marker lines such as [TRIGGER:CTA] become live beats if you want them. Running the prompter during the webinar happens in the console, not here. Side effect: it acts on your connected WordPress site; nothing else is touched. Words hosts use: teleprompter script, write script, webinar script, presenter notes, script for webinar

force.description: true writes a new script although one exists.

lang.description: The language to write in, when no script is given. Defaults to the campaign language.

script.description: The host's own text for the prompter. Leave it out to have a script written for this webinar.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_write_webinar_prompter
title: Write the teleprompter script
